nom: The INKEY List Hydrocolloid Invisible Pimple Patches + Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Two reviewers with oily skin report the patches stay put and remove whiteheads reliably, with one noting they hold even when skin is oilier than usual.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, acne-prone, ultra-sensitive skin found the patches effective without leaving skin sore or feeling unable to breathe; another simply notes they work on dry as well as normal skin.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers describe sensitive skin and report the patches pull out gunk and reduce redness without soreness or irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers mentioning menopause or being over 60 report the patches still help with occasional adult or hormonal breakouts.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible whiteheads or spots with a head are cleared or shrunk within hours to a couple of days; a few say results only appear with spots that already have a head, and one reviewer had no change at all after 48 hours.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe gunk being visibly drawn out of active breakouts, including deep or hormonal ones; dissent includes reviewers for whom patches did nothing or worsened a breakout into a bruise-like wound.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report visible reduction in redness and swelling overnight; no dissent noted on this specific point among positive reviewers, though overall efficacy is disputed by critics.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention using the patches for menopausal or adult-onset spots and find them helpful, without other aging-skin claims made.
concerns.barrier: One sensitive-skin reviewer reports no soreness or compromised feel after use; one critical reviewer reports the patch ripped the top layer of skin off in places.

extraits.texte: I've tried 4 brands of pimple patches and these are the ones I hated the most. They are very expensive for getting 1/3 the amount of patches that other brands offer for the same price. And are super thin and way too sticky, so they are hard to peel off the packaging without wrinkling them or folding up a side. Also, the surface area that's supposed to be over the pimple is so small. I had no results at all and instead it ripped the top layer of my skin off in certain areas. I do NOT recommend these at all.

I really wanted to like these, as I love other Inkey List products, but these just aren't great. They wrinkle up very easily, aren't very sticky and you get a really small amount of surface area for the price in comparison to other brands. I can see how beneficial they can be for wearing with makeup, as they are very thin, however, i'd recommend applying them before any skincare as they lose their stickiness with the slightest bit of moisture on the face. Also be incredibly careful removing them from their packaging as they wrinkle up / lose their clarity with any contact to your fingers and will refuse to stick whatsoever. Overall, they do help with pimples in my opinion if you manage to get one on properly, but if you're the type to just throw these on in a rush before bed / work just stick with the Hero mighty pimple patches.. better bang for your buck in comparison and always reliable.

I struggle with adult breakouts . Sometimes they're mild & other times they're worse . No exaggerating I tried about 15 different pimple patches . I bought these about a week ago . I have a few pimples that just won't go away. Used the whole box & just got another 'cause they work so well . I wore them at night & during day . Also sometimes with makeup 'cause they're that thin . Hydrocolloid is a must in a pimple patch( even tho they all don't have it) these patches shrunk the pesky pimples that would never go completely away which is why I just grabbed another box. I'm pretty sure 💪 that they'll be gone after a patch or 2 ., idk if it's the zucchini acid but it sucks the gunk out 🥵😊 and significantly shrinks the pimple. It's also a very reasonable price . I wish that I had a b4 pic

these patches adhere so well. theyre easy to remove from their sheet if you follow along the perferated line. they are truly unnoticable (unless a ton of gunk is sucked up). i have oily skin and lately more oily than usual and yet these patches dont budge. removing my white head everytime. only downside is i wish there were two sheets in the package instead of one.

These are the first pimple patches I've used that actually work. Very handy for covering spots and you can put makeup over them, and they genuinely pull the gunk out of spots and reduce redness noticeably. Will definitely buy again. (For reference, I have dry, acne-prone and ultra-sensitive skin)

I tried a couple of cheaper patches before these and the extra cost is so worth it. They are seriously effective, I've not had a spot these didn't clear yet. I have sensitive skin and they don't leave it sore or feeling like it can't breathe like the other brands I tried
I over 60 and still break out. I have tried these patches and they work for me.
